about: The order of the entries in the book: the 2013 print master’s (Cryptofloricon Master Pages for print v1.pdf, April 2013), where entry n is on page n. It is an editorial sequence, not by number, code or title: it opens with I love you, I like you and By way of introduction, runs loosely through a courtship and its aftermath with opposites side by side (I can wait / I can’t wait, You win / You lose, Yes / No), and ends with My work here is done. Each number is a lexicon id; every entry appears exactly once (test/book.test.js).
source: Read page by page from the 2013 print master (Dropbox /Cryptofloricon/Book Layout/), 2026-11-23
